question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"into."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Into"** is the correct preposition to use when indicating movement from the outside to the inside of something.
 
• The sentence suggests that something is being filled or inserted into the blank, hence the use of **"into"**.
 
• Grammatically, **"into"** is a preposition that indicates movement or direction towards the inside of something.
 
 
• **Example**: *She poured the milk **into**__ the bowl.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

To my utter __astonishment,__ the little dark boy was striding __imperiously__ up and down the lawn while the white youngster walked abjectly behind him. “Get me a banana!” The little boy ran __**into**__ the house and ______ (5) ______ shortly.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Up"**, is not appropriate in this context as it suggests movement towards the top or higher position, which does not fit with the sentence. 
 
• **"Down"**, is also not appropriate as it suggests movement towards the bottom or lower position, which does not fit with the sentence.
 
• **"In",** is a possible choice but it is less precise than "into" as it can also indicate a location or state of being within something.
